post.summary: Insert an element into a draft layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to an unsaved draft layout and returns the re-resolved tree plus a diagnostics report, without persisting. Inserts a new element of the given `type` at the root, or into `parentElementId`/`slot` at the optional `index` (a null, negative, or out-of-range index appends). When the optional `bindingSpecificationId` is given, the named binding specification's wiring is applied onto the fresh element atomically after scaffold (data requirements, seeded input defaults, and attribution), in the same edit; an unregistered id is rejected with `400` (`bindingSpecificationNotFound`) and a specification whose declared `type` does not match the inserted `type` with `400` (`bindingTypeMismatch`), and nothing is inserted on either failure. The optional `rootSource` resolves the draft against a root source's context so resolvability is evaluated; with it unset, only intrinsic well-formedness is checked. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. Structural impossibilities (`mutationSlotRequired`, `mutationUnknownType`, a malformed layout) are rejected with `400`; resolvability problems are reported in the `diagnostics` body at `200`, not as errors. A non-empty `rootSource` that is not a registered root source is rejected with `400` (`unknownRootSource`). Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`).

post.summary: Remove an element from a draft layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to an unsaved draft layout and returns the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics, without persisting. Removes `elementId` and its whole subtree. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. A referenced id that is not in the layout, or a malformed layout, is rejected with `400`. A non-empty `rootSource` that is not a registered root source is rejected with `400` (`unknownRootSource`). Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`).

post.summary: Move an element within a draft layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to an unsaved draft layout and returns the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics, without persisting. Moves `elementId` under `newParentId`/`newSlot` (root when `newParentId` is omitted) at the optional `index`, which counts the sibling list after the moved element is removed. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. Moving an element into itself or a descendant (`mutationCycle`), or omitting a required slot (`mutationSlotRequired`), is rejected with `400`. A non-empty `rootSource` that is not a registered root source is rejected with `400` (`unknownRootSource`). Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`).

post.summary: Replace an element's type in a draft layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to an unsaved draft layout and returns the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics, without persisting. Replaces the type of `elementId` with `newType`. Anything the new type cannot keep is returned, never silently lost: detached children in `orphaned` (re-place them with `attach-element`), wiring keys in `droppedWiring`, and static property values in `droppedProperties`. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. An unregistered `newType` (`mutationUnknownType`) or a malformed layout is rejected with `400`. A non-empty `rootSource` that is not a registered root source is rejected with `400` (`unknownRootSource`). Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`).

post.summary: Duplicate an element in a draft layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to an unsaved draft layout and returns the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics, without persisting. Duplicates `elementId` and its subtree, placing the copy at the optional `index` (next sibling when omitted). The copy and its descendants receive freshly minted ids, returned in `affectedElementIds`. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. A referenced id that is not in the layout, or a malformed layout, is rejected with `400`. A non-empty `rootSource` that is not a registered root source is rejected with `400` (`unknownRootSource`). Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`).

post.summary: Wrap sibling elements in a new container
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to an unsaved draft layout and returns the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics, without persisting. Wraps `elementIds` (a non-empty, duplicate-free set of siblings in one slot, or all roots) in a new container of `containerType`, placed into its `slot`. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. Empty or non-sibling targets (`mutationInvalidWrapTargets`), an unregistered `containerType` (`mutationUnknownType`), or a missing slot (`mutationSlotRequired`) is rejected with `400`. A non-empty `rootSource` that is not a registered root source is rejected with `400` (`unknownRootSource`). Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`).

post.summary: Unwrap a container in a draft layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to an unsaved draft layout and returns the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics, without persisting. Removes the container `containerElementId`, lifting its children into the container's former position. The inverse of wrap-elements. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. A referenced id that is not in the layout, or a malformed layout, is rejected with `400`. A non-empty `rootSource` that is not a registered root source is rejected with `400` (`unknownRootSource`). Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`).

post.summary: Attach an element subtree into a draft layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to an unsaved draft layout and returns the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics, without persisting. Splices the supplied `element` subtree into the root, or into `parentElementId`/`slot` at the optional `index`. Every id in the subtree is re-minted server-side; the placed ids are returned in `affectedElementIds`. This is the inverse of the detachment a `replace` reports: hand an `orphaned` subtree (or any copy) back here to re-place it. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. A missing slot (`mutationSlotRequired`) or a malformed layout/element is rejected with `400`. A non-empty `rootSource` that is not a registered root source is rejected with `400` (`unknownRootSource`). Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`).

post.summary: Bind a specification to an element in a draft layout
post.description: Applies a single structural edit to an unsaved draft layout and returns the re-resolved tree plus diagnostics, without persisting. Binds `bindingSpecificationId`'s wiring onto `elementId`: each `resolves` entry becomes a concrete reference wiring, merged into the element's existing wiring and overwriting the same keys; each `inputs` entry with a default seeds that primitive property only when the element does not already carry the key (an authored value, including an explicit null, is never overwritten); and every wired key's attribution is recorded. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. An unregistered `bindingSpecificationId` is rejected with `400` (`bindingSpecificationNotFound`); a specification whose declared `type` does not match the target element's `component` is rejected with `400` (`bindingTypeMismatch`); a referenced element id that is not in the layout, or a malformed layout, is rejected with `400`. A non-empty `rootSource` that is not a registered root source is rejected with `400` (`unknownRootSource`). Unknown request fields are rejected with `400` (`unknownRequestField`).
